title: Docker Mod manifest (mod.yml)
description: One per mod branch in docker-mods. The hub indexes every branch's mod.yml to build the mods API and site.

name.description: Mod name without the image prefix, e.g. 'python3'.

target.description: Image the mod applies to, or 'universal'.

bases.description: Base families the mod handles; universal mods usually list alpine and ubuntu.

images.description: Images the mod is recommended for besides its target, by image name. A universal mod lists the images where it is useful; the hub links the mod from those images' pages and run examples.

upstream.description: The upstream a mod packages, for mods that pin a tool version. The build passes the resolved version as the MOD_VERSION build arg and tags it; the control plane checks it hourly and builds the mod when that version has no tag yet. `version` is the default line, the one :<branch> follows; `lines` adds the further version lines upstream also ships (an older supported release, a release candidate), each checked, built and tagged on its own.

lines.description: Version lines besides the default one, in order of priority. A line's build tags :<branch>-<version> and its own `tags`, never :<branch>. Names are unique.

name.description: Short name, e.g. 'previous' or 'unstable'; the build's `line` input.

version.description: Superseded by upstream.version and read by nothing; removed at the next MAJOR.

upstream_source.description: The same source types as image.yml, resolved by the same resolver. Not os, command or deb_repo: the scheduler runs none of those.

line_tags.description: Floating tags a line's build also moves: `major` is :<branch>- and the version up to its first dot, `minor` up to its second dot (1 and 1.27 of 1.27.3). A version without that dot gets no such tag.
